subject: Leadership Summit — travel advances, hotel incident fee & card reconciliation
messages:
Message 1
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: amy@blueskytravel.com
Date: 2026-06-10 09:12 PDT
Subject: Leadership Summit — travel advances, hotel incident fee & card reconciliation

Team,

Quick heads up as we finalize logistics for the June 28–30 Leadership Summit in Seattle (Catalyst Systems). A few open items I need help with from Finance and Events: 

- Travel advances: we have 8 attendees (4 execs + 4 engineers). Can Finance issue per-person travel advances (air + estimated per-diem) or should we collect on a single PO? I attached an advance_request_Catalyst_June.docx with the attendee list and estimates.
- Corporate card: Harbor Hotel placed a $525 incident fee hold on the Redwood corporate card during check-in for room 512. Marcus used the corp card; he flagged the hold but it posted as a charge. I don’t have the folio yet — Harbor billing said they’d email confirmation but that hasn’t landed.
- Reimbursement path: if the incident fee remains and isn’t refunded, do we reimburse the employee or open a vendor dispute? Prefer opening a vendor dispute if Harbor can refund.

Please advise next steps and timeline — we need funds in peoples’ accounts by 6/24 so they can book.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop\VP, Customer Success\Redwood Inference

-----
Message 2
From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-11 10:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Leadership Summit — travel advances, hotel incident fee & card reconciliation

Lauren —

We can do the travel advances as individual ACH payments (quicker) or a single PO depending on Catalyst’s preferred flow. For speed, request ACH advances — send final amounts and bank details for each attendee by EOD 6/12.

On the Harbor Hotel charge: finance will need the final folio/invoice and the corporate card transaction detail to open a formal dispute with the bank. Please forward the Harbor billing email when it lands.

Action items:
- Lauren: confirm per-person advance amounts (attach bank details).
- Marcus: pull the card transaction (last four digits) and attach the charge screenshot.

I’ll prioritize the dispute once we have the invoice and charge info.

—Monica\Senior Finance Manager\Redwood Inference

-----
Message 3
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-15 14:20 PDT
Subject: Re: Leadership Summit — travel advances, hotel incident fee & card reconciliation

Monica —

Attached: harbor_hotel_folio_7891.pdf and a photo of the card transaction in our CC portal. Harbor says the $525 was posted as an "incident fee" for alleged minibar damages (there were none). Marcus confirms he paid no minibar/incident — room was left in order.

Folio summary: 1x room (2 nights) + incidental charge $525 (posted 06/12). Harbor billing wrote: \"Guest charged for alleged minibar usage 06/12 — folio 7891.\"

I’ve also added the per-person advance spreadsheet in the shared Drive. Please process the eight ACH advances for the listed amounts by 6/24. If Finance believes the vendor dispute route is faster, prioritize that and advise if we should issue temporary ACH to the employees while dispute resolves.

Thanks — forwarding Harbor thread below for reference.

Lauren

Message 4
From: Harbor Hotel Billing <billing@harborhotel.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-17 08:30 PDT
Subject: Re: Folio 7891 — Incident charge clarification

Ms. Bishop —

Thank you for reaching out. Per our records, folio 7891 shows an incidental charge labeled as "mini-bar/incidentals" for $525 posted on 2026-06-12. We can refund the charge pending completion of our incident review form and confirmation that no items were removed from the room. Please complete the attached Incident Review PDF and send any supporting photos. 

Attached: harbor_hotel_folio_7891.pdf (folio), incident_review_form.pdf (please complete).

If you prefer, we can issue a credit to the corporate card on file — please confirm the last four digits to match the charge.

Regards,
Harbor Hotel Billing Team
billing@harborhotel.com

Message 5
From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: lauren.bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-20 16:45 PDT
Subject: Re: Leadership Summit — travel advances, hotel incident fee & card reconciliation

Lauren / Monica —

Update from Finance: I provided the card upload and transaction screenshot. Monica has opened a dispute with the bank (case #BK-2026-4412). Harbor confirmed they will process an internal review; they offered a direct credit if we confirm last four digits on the card (ending 9243).

Monica will initiate provisional ACH advances to the 8 travelers tomorrow morning to avoid any booking delays; Finance will reduce the employees’ next expense reimbursement if/when the vendor credit posts. Monica, please confirm the ACH batch reference here once sent.

Action log:
- Monica: open dispute (done) — bank case BK-2026-4412.
- Monica: ACH provisional advances to 8 employees — scheduled 2026-06-21 AM.
- Lauren: collect any photos from the rooms (none expected) and sign/return Harbor incident_review_form.pdf.

Attaching the expense report template for your records.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin\Director, Events\Redwood Inference
